profileIdentity.businessDescription750Chars: NaturesMud Nepal (Baneshwor, Kathmandu 44600) is a single-ingredient natural foods brand offering 32 whole-food products across Nepal: Fruit & Vegetable Powders (Beetroot, Dates, Moringa, Carrot, Sweet Potato, Banana, Freeze-Dried Avocado & Strawberry), Dehydrated Fruits (Mango, Pineapple, Apple, Dragon Fruit, Sweet Papaya, Coconut Chips, Blueberries, Cranberries, Dry Figs & Dates), Mountain Nuts (Almonds, Cashewnuts, Pistachios, Macadamia & Mix Dry Nuts), Superfood Seeds (Chia, Pumpkin, Flax & Makhana), Cold-Pressed Coconut Oils (500 ML & 180 ML), Rosemary Leaves, Himalayan Salts & Pure Mountain Himalayan Shilajit Resin. 0% added sugar, 0% preservatives. 24-hour Kathmandu Valley delivery & nationwide COD.
attributes: Nationwide Courier Delivery across all 77 Districts of Nepal
Nepali women & smallholder farmer sourcing network

qaSeedPairs.question: Where is NaturesMud located in Kathmandu and how fast is delivery?
qaSeedPairs.answer: Our main quality inspection and dispatch hub is in Baneshwor, Kathmandu 44600, Nepal (+977-9713888002). Orders inside Kathmandu, Lalitpur, and Bhaktapur are delivered within 24 hours (Rs. 100 delivery fee, FREE on orders Rs. 2,000+).

qaSeedPairs.question: Which NaturesMud powders are suitable for babies starting solid food (lito / porridge)?
qaSeedPairs.answer: Our 100% single-ingredient Dates Powder (Khajoor ko Dhulo), Sweet Potato Powder, Carrot Powder, and Banana Powder contain 0% refined sugar, 0% salt, and 0% preservatives, making them ideal for homemade porridge and lito (from 6 months, as advised by your pediatrician).

qaSeedPairs.question: Can I buy NaturesMud products in retail stores in Kathmandu, Pokhara, or Surkhet?
qaSeedPairs.answer: Yes! Selected NaturesMud products are stocked at Kids Kottage (Gongabu, Kupondol, Kapan, Pokhara & Surkhet), Zero to Ten (Chabahil), and Baby Love (Hetauda). For all 32 products and fresh batch dispatch, order at naturesmud.shop.

qaSeedPairs.question: Do your Dehydrated Mango, Pineapple, and Apple slices have added sugar?
qaSeedPairs.answer: No. All NaturesMud dehydrated fruits are made from 100% ripe fruit slices gently dehydrated at low temperatures with 0% added sugar, 0% artificial colors, and 0% preservatives.

qaSeedPairs.question: Is NaturesMud Extra Virgin Coconut Oil packed in glass or plastic?
qaSeedPairs.answer: Both sizes of our cold-pressed coconut oil—Extra Virgin Coconut Oil (500 ML, Rs. 1,750) and Virgin Coconut Oil (180 ML, Rs. 650)—are packed in food-grade wide-mouth glass jars so they never leach plastic and are easy to scoop in winter.

qaSeedPairs.question: How do I verify my NaturesMud order or leave a product review?
qaSeedPairs.answer: Every review on naturesmud.shop requires a real NaturesMud Order Number (e.g., NM-420417) from your delivery invoice or WhatsApp confirmation. We never publish unverified or synthetic ratings.

qaSeedPairs.question: Do you deliver to Pokhara, Chitwan, Butwal, Biratnagar, and Dharan with Cash on Delivery?
qaSeedPairs.answer: Yes, we deliver to all 7 provinces and 77 districts of Nepal within 2–5 business days with Cash on Delivery (COD), FonePay QR, eSewa, and Khalti. Outside Valley courier fee is Rs. 150 (FREE on orders Rs. 2,000+).

qaSeedPairs.question: What is your return or replacement policy if a jar is damaged in transit?
qaSeedPairs.answer: We offer a 7-day hassle-free replacement or refund policy (/returns). Simply message us on WhatsApp at +977-9713888002 with your Order Number and a photo of the package within 7 days of delivery.
